name: @zestty/native
description: Native (napi) binding to the zestty compiler. Linux x64 only for now; run `npm run build:native` at the repo root to (re)build.

scripts.prepublishOnly: test -f zestty.linux-x64-gnu.node || (echo 'native binary missing: run npm run build:native at the repo root' && exit 1)
